objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed override governance that never converts a safety VETO into pre-trade eligibility, while producing auditable WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL records for explicit override requests.
scope: Allow ordinary PRETRADE_G_ELIGIBLE only when P16-F is eligible and no override is requested
Preserve upstream P16-F VETO as VETO when no override request exists
Represent any explicit override request as WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, never as eligible
Require requester identity, bounded scope, reason, evidence SHA-256, request timestamp and expiry
Require explicit governed maximum override-request TTL
Fail closed on future, expired or overlong override requests
out_of_scope: Resetting circuit breakers or kill switches
tests: Eligible P16-F with no override emits PRETRADE_G_ELIGIBLE
P16-F VETO with no override remains VETO
Any valid override request emits WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL and never eligibility
Override request exceeding explicit TTL fails closed
No approval, reset, G8 or execution authority is emitted
P16-G evidence is byte-identical across two runs
evidence: Automation Governance / Owner Gates / Change Control evidence
rollback: Revert P16-G module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P16-F remains canonical complete and P16-H remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: No VETO-to-PASS or auto-approval path exists
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
